audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..3].side read "Xerath" and phases[4..6].side read "Skill", but content win[] (matching the packet levelChart and Yuumi's 50.12% WR over 2937 games) says Yuumi wins levels 1-5 and Xerath wins first item and 2+ items — the reverse of the early split.
audit.why: Xerath's early poke is all telegraphed charge-ups (Arcanopulse) and a slow zone (Eye of Destruction) that attached healing absorbs; he only out-damages sustain once Lost Chapter/Luden's lands, matching content's own whys[].
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..3].side = "Yuumi" and phases[4..6].side = "Xerath", with rewritten why lines grounded in his kit (see edits).

audit.why: content spikes[] correctly identify the first-item Luden's spike and level-6 R being low-value in a 2v2 lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions file flags two unmentioned facts: Xerath's Rite of the Arcane (R) is a channel that Yuumi's You and Me! (W) cancels outright, and Xerath can cancel Yuumi's own channeled Final Chapter (R) with Shocking Orb (E) or his own R. Neither appears anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Both are real, kit-sourced facts (Xerath R flagged channel, Yuumi R flagged channel/interruptible in their respective kit files) that change how each side should sequence ultimates.

edits.before: Poke from the saddle — the attached Q steers and the lane can't bill you for it.
edits.after: His Q charge and W zone are dodgeable while attached — heal off any chip that lands.

edits.before: Dismount windows begin: the passive autos shield and heal; schedule them carefully.
edits.after: His slow combo can't out-trade your empowered Q plus constant heals.

edits.before: Full rhythm: attach for the trades, dismount for the passive, never linger between.
edits.after: Your sustain erases his chip before he has mana to spike his combo.

edits.before: Zoomies the margins — the host's tempo is your tempo; bank the chip.
edits.after: You still out-heal his mana-starved artillery poke before his items land.

edits.before: Final Chapter online — the root waves referee every dive on your host.
edits.after: His R snipes are low-value against a juke-and-heal pattern — but his spike looms.

edits.before: First item: the heals compound and the steered Qs chunk.
edits.after: Lost Chapter/Luden's combos and E-stun setups finally out-damage your heals.

edits.before: Late Yuumi is the unkillable second health bar: attach, amplify, and out-vote the focus fire.
edits.after: Off-screen combos plus R snipes out-range your sustain from every angle.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W attach (untargetability) banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — his only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. - His Rite of the Arcane (R) is a channel; your W (You and Me!) cancels it outright if you can reach him. - He can cancel your own channeled R with Shocking Orb or his R, so only cast Final Chapter once his CC is spent.
